## How to test

1. Run unit tests (`make check`).

## Checklist
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (lint, type-check, tests, build)
- [ ] No secrets, real bills, or personal health data committed
- [ ] Zero-retention privacy policy strictly observed (no disk/log persistence of raw files)
- [ ] User-facing wording uses non-accusatory language ("possible overcharge")
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Screenshots attached (for UI changes)
